$comment: Halal (non-musical, natural-source) sound effects for apps and motion graphics. url = jsDelivr CDN (cached, CORS-enabled), raw = GitHub raw. Generated by scripts/build.mjs, do not edit by hand.
name: halal-sound-effects

app/interaction.title: Interaction
app/interaction.description: Direct touch feedback: taps, toggles, selection, drag and drop, sliders and keyboards.

app/feedback.title: Feedback
app/feedback.description: Results of an action: success, error, warning, info, achievements, lock and unlock, copy and undo.

app/navigation.title: Navigation
app/navigation.description: Moving around the app: screens, tabs, modals, sheets, menus, expand and collapse.

app/messaging.title: Messaging
app/messaging.description: Chat and calls: send, receive, mentions, reactions, typing, ringtones and voice notes.

app/content.title: Content
app/content.description: Working with items: save, add, delete, share, favorite, search, uploads, downloads and loading.

app/islamic.title: Islamic
app/islamic.description: For Muslim apps: Quran reading, tasbih counters, prayer and wudu reminders, qibla, dua, iftar and suhoor.

app/system.title: System
app/system.description: App-level events: launch, sign in and out, payments, timers, alarms, connectivity and battery.

motion/transitions.title: Transitions
motion/transitions.description: For motion graphics and video: whooshes, swishes, slides, zooms, wipes and page curls.

motion/reveals.title: Reveals
motion/reveals.description: For motion graphics and video: logo stings, text and calligraphy reveals, pops, shimmer and unveils.

motion/impacts.title: Impacts
motion/impacts.description: For motion graphics and video: soft and deep hits, splashes, bounces, thuds and snaps.

motion/risers.title: Risers
motion/risers.description: For motion graphics and video: natural wind, water and sand risers, downers and breaths. No synths.
